name: Rifugio Bonatti, Val Ferret
why: A short climb through larches to the hut with the best front-row view of the Grandes Jorasses and the Mont Blanc glaciers.
book: Nothing for a day walk. Val Ferret road is closed to cars above Planpincieux on summer days: shuttle bus from Courmayeur to Lavachey. Book the hut weeks ahead to sleep (it is a Tour du Mont Blanc stage).
water: At the hut (drinks and meals June to September); streams on the way.
dangers: Afternoon storms on the open balcony.
Snow patches above the hut until early July.
turnaround: With dark clouds over Mont Blanc, stay at the hut or go back down by the same path.

points.name: Val Ferret meadows at Lavachey
points.note: 1,700 m: the flat floor of the valley, the Dora river and larches. Path 42 starts by the Malatrà stream.

points.name: Rifugio Bonatti
points.note: 2,025 m: the stone hut on its open balcony, the Grandes Jorasses and its glaciers straight across the valley. Meals and beds.
